title: CLI for outside programs: agent-plan serve and init options
description:
Current state: packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts has no `serve`; plan-server starts from packages/plan-server/src/cli.ts via PLAN_PORT/PLAN_HOST/PLAN_ROOT and serve() in serve.ts. initPlanner (index.ts:102) sets only the name and returns silently when .planner/ exists.

Work: add `agent-plan serve [--root --port --host --json]` reusing serve() (port 0 = OS-assigned, prints address; --json prints one JSON line {url, host, port, root}). Extend `agent-plan init` with --description, --goal, --json and a distinct machine-readable already-exists result. Use mkdtemp fixtures only.

Not in scope: the cascade feature-delete bug reported by heca-pro is already fixed by commit 840db0c (tombstone in packages/plan-core/src/feature-delete.ts, test in packages/plan-core/test/feature-delete.test.mjs); it ships in the next release.

Preserve: existing init behaviour and prompts without flags; env-var start path of plan-server; planner disabled by default. All source text in English.

tasks.title: agent-plan serve command
tasks.description:
Add `agent-plan serve [--root <dir>] [--port <n>] [--host <h>] [--json]` to packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts (usage() at :20, parseFlags :75, main :396). It calls serve() from @agent-plan/server (packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:1661; options port/planRoot/host/quiet, handle has url/localUrl/lanUrl/mode/bindHost/close). Today plan-server starts only from packages/plan-server/src/cli.ts through PLAN_PORT/PLAN_HOST/PLAN_ROOT. Defaults: root = ./.planner (plannerRoot()), host 127.0.0.1, port 3030; port 0 lets the OS pick. Print the address; with --json print exactly one JSON line {url, localUrl, lanUrl, host, port, root} and nothing else on stdout. Keep the process running until SIGINT/SIGTERM, then close() cleanly. Errors (missing .planner/, port in use) go to stderr with exit code 1. Add @agent-plan/server as a workspace dependency of the agent-plan package (check there is no dependency cycle). Test with mkdtemp fixture and port 0 in packages/agent-plan/test. Edge cases: --port not a number, unknown flags, root without planner.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped `agent-plan serve [--root <.planner dir>] [--port n] [--host h] [--json]` in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts (serveCommand, parsePort, parseFlags now handles value flags incl. --name=value). It loads @agent-plan/server lazily, prints the address (or one JSON line {url, localUrl, lanUrl, host, port, root} with the real port when --port 0), stops cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM, and exits 1 with a stderr message for a missing planner or a bad port. Added @agent-plan/server as workspace dependency (package.json, tsconfig reference, pnpm-lock.yaml; no cycle: server depends only on core). Verified: new packages/agent-plan/test/serve.test.mjs (4 tests, mkdtemp fixtures, port 0) plus all existing agent-plan CLI tests: 20/20 pass; package builds. Not verified: full repository gate (reserved for phase close). Value flags --description/--goal are already parsed and used by T447. Note: --root is the .planner folder itself, same as AGENT_PLAN_ROOT.

tasks.title: agent-plan init: --description, --goal, --json, already-exists result
tasks.description:
Extend initPlanner (packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:102). Today it sets only the project name (PlanStore.init, plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1512) and, when .planner/ exists, prints a message and returns with exit code 0 — indistinguishable from success. Add --description <text> and --goal <text> (Project has goal and description fields, plan-core/src/schema.ts:145-146; set them through PlanStore.updateProject at plan-store.ts:2575 after init), and --json. With --json print one JSON line: {status: "created"|"exists", root, name}. When the planner already exists, --json reports status "exists" and exit code stays 0 but the status field tells the caller; without --json keep the current message. Flags --description/--goal on an existing planner must not overwrite anything (report exists). Parse flags with values in parseFlags (:75), which today only handles booleans. Keep the prompts and behaviour without flags unchanged. Test with mkdtemp fixtures: created with description/goal, exists, no flags.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped `agent-plan init` options in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts (initPlanner): --description and --goal set Project fields via PlanStore.updateProject right after creation; --json prints one line {status: "created"|"exists", root, name}; with --json (or --yes) it never prompts and defaults the name to the folder name. An existing planner is never modified (reports "exists", exit 0; text output unchanged). A value flag without a value exits 1. Documented in README.md (CLI section, init and serve) and packages/agent-plan/README.md. Verified: new packages/agent-plan/test/init-options.test.mjs (5 tests, mkdtemp fixtures) plus serve, version and guard tests: 17/17 pass; package builds. Not verified: full repository gate (reserved for phase close); no installed-artifact smoke test yet.
